description: Open path: write native code under a harmless suffix into the work dir and load it with ExtensionFileLoader from the import machinery kept in sys.modules. dlopen emits no audit event, so the hooks cannot refuse it; only the OS isolation contains what it runs. The plugin writes no real library: an ImportError naming the file proves the loader tried.

open_path.note: native code from the work dir: dlopen emits no audit event; under bwrap and setuid what it runs stays in the box (MSHL-191)
